name: Natsu e no Hakobune II
source:
The first summer vacation after being out of town, for the first time after several months, the protagonist returns to his hometown. Even though the circumstances have changed, his summer begins like always......or it should have been.

Unexpectedly, a story about his cousin's arranged marriage comes up. And as a result, the protagonist eventually realizes the hidden feelings of his cousin, his younger sister, and his childhood friend──

By being deeply connected with these girls, a new kind of summer begins.

Set during the summer in the countryside, with the alluring love and desire of these 3 girls intertwine, begins an immoral love story.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://argonauts-soft.com/products/ms30/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
出城后的第一个暑假，时隔数月，主人公第一次回到家乡。尽管情况发生了变化，他的夏天还是一如既往地开始了……或者应该是这样。

不料，堂弟包办婚姻的故事却发生了。结果，主角最终认识到了表弟、妹妹、青梅竹马的隐藏感情——

通过与这些女孩建立深厚的联系，一个新的夏天开始了。

以夏天的乡村为背景，三个女孩的诱人爱情与欲望交织在一起，展开了一段不道德的爱情故事。

[翻译编辑自[url=https://argonauts-soft.com/products/ms30/#story]官网[/url]]
